entries.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
entries.summary: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

entries.title: Searching for distant planets with Astra
entries.summary: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

entries.title: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
entries.summary: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

entries.title: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
entries.summary: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

entries.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
entries.summary: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

entries.title: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
entries.summary: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

entries.title: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
entries.summary: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

entries.title: Perplexity and Intelligence
entries.summary: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

entries.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
entries.summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

entries.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
entries.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

entries.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
entries.summary: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

entries.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
entries.summary: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

entries.title: See PR scans in action
entries.summary: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

entries.title: Deploying Daybreak Red
entries.summary: Explore a reference architecture for supervised security investigations with Daybreak Red, including safety controls, setup, and monitoring.

entries.title: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
entries.summary: Watch a demo of the Codex Security Plugin and see the workflow in action, from getting started to reviewing the results shown in the recording.

entries.title: Get started with Daybreak Blue
entries.summary: Watch a walkthrough of onboarding to Daybreak Blue, with a closer look at the setup experience and how to get started.

entries.title: The Silent Consensus
entries.summary: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

entries.title: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
entries.summary: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.

entries.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
entries.summary: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

entries.title: Inside the Codex sandbox
entries.summary: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

entries.title: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
entries.summary: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

entries.title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
entries.summary: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro’s journalism to ChatGPT through summaries and excerpts, with links to original stories.

entries.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
entries.summary: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

entries.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
entries.summary: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
